structure.summary: This partial tender document outlines Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Limited’s invitation for sealed bids to design, supply, install, test, and commission electrical systems at selected stations for Phase II of the Namma Metro extension. It details the project scope—station lighting, power distribution panels, emergency backup, earthing, and lightning protection—along the North–South corridor. The document specifies bid submission requirements (electronic portal, required company, GST, financial statements, project certificates), bid security (INR 50 lakh EMD), and a non‑refundable tender fee (INR 10 000). Eligibility criteria cover financial qualifications (minimum turnover of INR 100 crore, positive net worth, audited financials) and technical qualifications (at least two similar projects of INR 30 crore each, qualified engineers). It describes the work scope in detail (main distribution panels, cabling standards, LED platform lighting, emergency lighting, earthing, lightning arrestors). Payment terms include a 10 % advance, milestone‑based interim payments, and final payment upon commissioning. The contract duration is 18 months with defined milestones for installation (12 months) and testing/commissioning (6 months). Penalties for delays and liquidated damages are also referenced.

nodes.title: Financial Qualification
Minimum Turnover
nodes.summary: The document outlines the eligibility criteria for bidders, covering both financial and technical qualifications. It specifies a minimum annual turnover of INR 100 crore over the last three years, a positive net worth for the previous year, and required financial documents (audited balance sheets, profit‑and‑loss statements, and auditor certification). Technically, bidders must have completed at least two comparable electrical infrastructure projects in metro rail or large infrastructure within the past seven years, each with a contract value of at least INR 30 crore, and must possess qualified engineers in electrical engineering, power systems, and safety compliance. The document also introduces a section on the scope of work.

nodes.title: Advance Payment

The partial document outlines the electrical and project management requirements for a metro station construction contract. Key points include:

- **Electrical Power Distribution (Section 4.1)**: Installation of main low‑tension distribution panels in designated station rooms, compliance with Indian standards for cabling, and safety regulations.
- **Station Lighting Systems (Section 4.2)**: Placement of LED fixtures along passenger platforms and automatic activation of emergency lighting during power failures.
- **Earthing and Lightning Protection (Section 4.3)**: Mandatory installation of a comprehensive earthing system and lightning arrestors per safety standards.
